# Third-Party Thanks

This file records dependencies and projects that ZenConverter relies on or
learns from. Add entries before a dependency becomes part of the build.

| Project | Use | License | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| AndroidX Compose | Planned UI toolkit | Apache-2.0 | Planned | Declared in Gradle skeleton. |
| AndroidX Material Icons Extended | App action/category icons | Apache-2.0 | Active | Official Compose icon set used for UI clarity. |
| PDFBox-Android | True PDF merge and selectable PDF text extraction | Apache-2.0 | Low-frequency maintenance | Local Maven Central AAR at `app/libs/pdfbox-android-2.0.27.0.aar`, SHA-256 `30277f879cfd571db2a137582c95516a0d4ea6778e945519bc58ca93d57d88c7`. Chosen because Android platform APIs do not provide broad loss-preserving PDF merge, and platform PDF text extraction is only available on newer API/extension levels. |
| Bouncy Castle Java APIs | Transitive crypto support required by PDFBox-Android | Bouncy Castle License, MIT-style | Active | Local Maven Central JARs `bcprov-jdk15to18`, `bcpkix-jdk15to18`, and `bcutil-jdk15to18` version `1.72`. Required by the PDFBox-Android POM, especially for PDF security/encryption handling. |
| FFmpegKitNext self-built AAR | FFmpeg compatibility remux/extract/transcode path | LGPLv3 main license; packaged GPL-family and codec notices including LAME, libiconv, libvpx, Opus, x264, x265, and cpu-features | Active local binary | Current local AAR is `app/libs/ffmpeg-kit-next-7.1.0.aar`, `arm64-v8a` only, SHA-256: `d1f2512e806ac3ff99b2f4c3d2e36fcca8c5c0eec548d84da81cf94d054cf406`. Exact replacement build command still needs to be recorded before a tagged release. |
| smart-exception-java / smart-exception-common | Transitive helper used by the FFmpeg AAR | BSD-3-Clause | Active transitive | Pulled by the FFmpegKit POM or matching local JAR fallback as `com.arthenica:smart-exception-java:0.2.1` and `com.arthenica:smart-exception-common:0.2.1`. |
| FFmpeg | Compatibility engine core inside the self-built FFmpegKitNext AAR | LGPL/GPL depending on linked libraries | Active | Current replacement AAR is arm64-only and packages notices for LAME, libiconv, libvpx, Opus, x264, and x265; exact configure flags still need to be recorded before release. |
| libzen_office2pdf.so | Experimental DOCX/PPTX/XLSX to PDF native renderer | Apache-2.0 source dependencies; local binary | Active local binary | Bundled only for `arm64-v8a` at `app/src/main/jniLibs/arm64-v8a/libzen_office2pdf.so`. Rebuilt on August 21, 2026 from `native/office2pdf-jni`; size `32,823,808` bytes, SHA-256 `2b36e907b772514cf8b5840de338dc21ffd6100b5e3e8f0487b6cd77b2958d5b`. Exports the explicit font-path JNI method required for bundled CJK font discovery. |
| office2pdf | Source dependency of the experimental Office JNI renderer | Apache-2.0 | Active upstream | Pinned in `native/office2pdf-jni/Cargo.toml` at `developer0hye/office2pdf` commit `8f34766a1d1567b9d81d606e45ea690987a7c6ed`, released as `v0.6.7`. It provides `ConvertOptions.font_paths` for explicit Typst font discovery. |
| jni-rs | Rust JNI bindings for the experimental Office renderer | Apache-2.0 OR MIT | Active upstream | Pinned as `jni` version `0.21.1` in `native/office2pdf-jni/Cargo.toml`. A full transitive Cargo license inventory remains a release gate. |
| woff2 | WOFF2 codec behind the font converter JNI | Apache-2.0 | Active upstream | Google's WOFF 2.0 reference implementation (`https://github.com/google/woff2`), linked statically into `libzen_woff2.so`. Handles WOFF2 only, not WOFF 1.0. |
| Brotli | Compression dependency of the woff2 codec | MIT | Active upstream | WOFF2 stores compressed table data with Brotli; linked statically into `libzen_woff2.so`. |
| libzen_woff2.so | WOFF2 compression/decompression native library | Apache-2.0 source (woff2) + MIT (Brotli); local binary | Active local binary | Bundled only for `arm64-v8a` at `app/src/main/jniLibs/arm64-v8a/libzen_woff2.so`, size `1,147,520` bytes, SHA-256 `dcc4ed659a792c70fa78f0daac13c8ff1102bc8dcf423c89d861b80843d205af`. Exports the `compress` and `decompress` JNI methods. Linked with `-Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384` for 16 KB page-size support. |
| Noto Sans CJK Regular | High-fidelity CJK sans font for experimental Office-to-PDF output | SIL Open Font License 1.1 | Active upstream font family | Downloaded on-demand from `https://assets.xlab.my/models/NotoSansCJK-Regular.ttc`, size `32,355,424` bytes, SHA-256 `3e7e5afaac2c6d872592d76abedac03a51c6f0fc42d11e311ff2816a6c368afe`. (System fonts used by default for 0 MB footprint). |
| Noto Serif CJK Regular | High-fidelity CJK serif font for SimSun-style Office documents | SIL Open Font License 1.1 | Active upstream font family | Downloaded on-demand from `https://assets.xlab.my/models/NotoSerifCJK-Regular.ttc`, size `26,273,008` bytes, SHA-256 `5dec6bbce13a3bbf1487a022392c23e571abd0696a102f3715697420dd94b47a`. (System fonts used by default for 0 MB footprint). |
| FFmpegKit | Reference only | LGPL/GPL depending on package | Reference | Original project is retired; do not rely on it blindly. |
| ncnn | Deep-learning image super-resolution and neural inference engine | BSD-3-Clause | Active | Tencent's high-performance neural network inference framework with Vulkan GPU compute acceleration (`https://github.com/Tencent/ncnn`). Bundled for `arm64-v8a` at `app/src/main/jniLibs/arm64-v8a/libncnn.so` and linked into `libzen_ncnn.so`. |
| Real-ESRGAN (NCNN) | `realesrgan-x4plus` & `realesrgan-x4plus-anime` NCNN model weights behind the 4× AI upscaler | BSD-3-Clause | Active upstream | Models downloaded at runtime as paired `.param` and `.bin` files from `https://assets.xlab.my/models/`. Source: `https://github.com/xinntao/Real-ESRGAN`. Not bundled in the repository or APK. |
